# Presence Detection

Detect whether one or more people or relevant targets are present in an environment using wireless sensing measurements.

**Aliases:** occupancy detection

**Datasets in catalogue:** 3

|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [5G-Enabled Multi-User Presence and Activity Dataset](../datasets/glasgow-multiuser-presence-activity.md) | Channel matrix | Presence label | Measurement | Indoor | Not applicable | Open |
| [UWB Non-Cooperative Contextual Sensing Dataset](../datasets/uwb-noncooperative-contextual-sensing.md) | Channel impulse response | Presence label | Measurement | Indoor, Residential | Not applicable | Open |
